curated_by: Claude (Opus 5.5) for the IPF side quest, 2026-10-28; every abstract read against its step
rules: A step's evidence is what the run cited for that step. A citation may move to another step of the same hypothesis when its text states that step; the move is recorded in `moved_from`.
A citation is excluded when its text does not state the step. The reason is recorded.
Every `quote` is a verbatim substring of the abstract or UniProt entry (checked by 02_render_lean.py).
Mouse-only evidence carries `taxon: mouse`. Claims stay context-free, so the taxon lint flags them; that is reported, not fixed.
A statement marked `bridge` is not in the run. It is a link the derivation needs and the run left out.
